units.source_text: 比起典礼的伴奏和节日的喧闹来，还是重山叠峦那悠扬的音乐和森林的歌声更能渗进千重子的心坎。

en.t: More than the ceremonial accompaniment or the bustle of the festival, it was the lingering music of the layered mountains and the song of the forest that seeped deepest into Chieko's heart.

units.source_text: 她仿佛穿过北山浓重的彩虹，倾听那音乐和歌声……

en.t: It was as though she were passing through the dense rainbow over Kitayama, listening to that music and those voices singing...
